en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Salih Bin Al Sandy, from Ja’far Bin Basheer, from Aban Bin Usman who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a divorce of the mute. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should wrap her scarf upon her head and pull it away’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Salih ibn al-Sindiy from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Aban ibn ‘Uthman who has said the following: “
I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who is speechless. He (the Imam) said, ‘He must wrap her scarf around her head, then pull it away.’”
